summary: Code::Blocks 25.03 brings everything changed since 20.03. It adds support for C++23 and C++26, detects MinGW64, MSYS2, MSVC 17 and TDM compilers, reworks drag and drop in the project tree, and improves high-DPI screens. The CDB debugger gains thread lists, local variables and memory views, and Symbol Browser is back.
